schema_fields.name: game_key
schema_fields.label: Game ID
schema_fields.description: Identifies the game; plays with the same value belong to one game.

schema_fields.name: offense
schema_fields.label: Offense
schema_fields.description: Team with the ball (abbreviation, 1-5 letters or digits).

schema_fields.name: play_type
schema_fields.label: Play type
schema_fields.description: pass, run, punt, field_goal, kickoff, extra_point, qb_kneel, qb_spike, or no_play. Sacks are passes; scrambles are runs.

schema_fields.name: down
schema_fields.label: Down
schema_fields.description: Down (1-4); blank for kickoffs and tries.

schema_fields.name: yard_line_100
schema_fields.label: Yards from end zone
schema_fields.description: Distance from the opponent's end zone (1-99).

schema_fields.name: score_differential
schema_fields.label: Score differential
schema_fields.description: Offense score minus defense score before the play.

schema_fields.name: epa
schema_fields.label: EPA
schema_fields.description: Expected points added, if your data has it. Never estimated.

schema_fields.name: success
schema_fields.label: Success
schema_fields.description: Successful play (if omitted and EPA is mapped, success = EPA > 0).

schema_fields.name: first_down
schema_fields.label: First down
schema_fields.description: Play earned a first down (including by penalty).

schema_fields.name: first_down_penalty
schema_fields.label: First down by penalty
schema_fields.description: First down awarded by a defensive penalty.

schema_fields.name: third_down_converted
schema_fields.label: Third down converted
schema_fields.description: Offense converted on third down (if omitted and First down is mapped, third-down plays use First down).

schema_fields.name: two_point_attempt
schema_fields.label: Two-point attempt
schema_fields.description: Play was a two-point try (excluded from scrimmage metrics).
